key.name: refresh-interval
key.summary: Refresh interval in seconds

key.name: api-refresh-interval
key.summary: Seconds between background refreshes of every configured vendor's cache (0 = only on demand)
key.description: The main interval only fetches the vendor shown in the panel, so every other vendor's "Status das APIs" row ages until something asks for it. This runs the binary once per enabled+configured vendor in the background. Each run still honors the binary's own 60s cache TTL. 0 disables it, leaving "Verificar todas agora" as the only refresh.

key.name: vendor
key.summary: Provider shown in the top bar. The click menu lists every enabled provider.

key.name: binary-path
key.summary: Absolute path to the ai-usagebar binary (empty = auto-detect on PATH / ~/.cargo/bin)

key.name: menu-summary-style
key.summary: Provider summaries in the menu: bars and values, or values only

key.name: menu-show-icons
key.summary: Show symbolic provider icons in the menu

key.name: menu-compact
key.summary: Use compact spacing in the provider menu

key.name: bar-width
key.summary: Width of each bar in cells

key.name: show-percent
key.summary: Show the numeric percentage next to each bar

key.name: show-session
key.summary: Show the 5-hour session bar

key.name: show-weekly
key.summary: Show the weekly bar

key.name: panel-box
key.summary: Which panel area to live in (right = next to network/clock)

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Position index within the chosen panel area

key.name: show-extra
key.summary: Show the extra-usage (cost) bar as a third bar

key.name: show-bars
key.summary: Draw the bars; when off, show only the percentages

key.name: color-low
key.summary: Bar color for <50% usage

key.name: color-mid
key.summary: Bar color for 50-74% usage

key.name: color-high
key.summary: Bar color for 75-89% usage

key.name: color-critical
key.summary: Bar color for 90%+ usage

key.name: color-empty
key.summary: Color of the empty part of the bar

key.name: panel-entries
key.summary: Providers and accounts the panel shows side by side
key.description: Each id is a row of the aggregate report: a vendor ('openai') or a named Anthropic account ('anthropic@claude-b3'). With one or more ids here the panel draws a segment per id, in this order, for each window show-session/show-weekly selects, and the 'vendor' key only chooses whose detail the dropdown shows. Empty (the default) keeps the single-provider panel driven by 'vendor'.

key.name: panel-pools
key.summary: Which quota pools the panel shows (vendors with two independent pools only)
key.description: Combines with show-session/show-weekly: the panel draws one segment per selected pool per selected window. 'auto' shows the primary pool and falls back to an available secondary once the primary reaches the threshold.

key.name: panel-auto-threshold
key.summary: Usage percentage at which the 'auto' pool mode switches to the other pool
